items.headline: Anthropic Researcher Resigns, Warns AI Companies Are 'Gambling With Our Lives'
items.summary: Jacob Coxon, who did pretraining research at both OpenAI and Anthropic, publicly resigned warning that AI labs are racing toward self-improving superintelligence without adequate safety measures, a claim several Anthropic staff publicly endorsed.

items.headline: OpenAI Says Unreleased Model Solved the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize Problem
items.summary: OpenAI claims an internal model more capable than GPT-6 Astra, using roughly 10,000 concurrent AI agents over 88 hours, produced a proof that 3D Navier-Stokes equations can develop a finite-time singularity, though the claim is disputed amid a credit controversy with independent mathematicians who had researched related equations for nearly a year.

items.headline: US Intelligence Agencies Accuse Six Chinese AI Firms of 'Industrial-Scale' Model Distillation
items.summary: A joint NSA, CISA, and FBI advisory alleges DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, Alibaba, MiniMax, StepFun, and Z.AI extracted billions of tokens from US frontier models including Claude, GPT, Gemini, and Grok since late 2024, using fraudulent accounts and proxy routing to evade detection.

items.headline: Google DeepMind Releases AlphaGenome Atlas, a 1-Petabyte Map of the Human Genome
items.summary: The free resource offers precomputed molecular-effect predictions for all 9 billion possible single-nucleotide variants in human DNA, acting as a genomics successor to the AlphaFold Database and already helping researchers identify disease-associated variants.

items.headline: Fields Medalist Jacob Tsimerman Launches Mathematical AI Safety Institute
items.summary: Modeled on Princeton's Institute for Advanced Study, the new institute aims to build rigorous mathematical frameworks for AI safety and plans to grow to 30-100 researchers by late 2027; Tsimerman will simultaneously join OpenAI's safety team.

items.headline: AI Coding Startup Cognition Raises $2 Billion at $48 Billion Valuation
items.summary: The Series E round, led by Andreessen Horowitz and Accel, nearly doubles Cognition's valuation from May as run-rate revenue for its Devin autonomous coding agent grew from $492 million to nearly $900 million.

items.headline: Qualcomm and AWS Strike Multi-Generation Deal for Custom AI Inference Chips
items.summary: The partnership will co-design custom AI-inference silicon and optical connectivity up to 1.6 Tbit/s for AWS data centers, with Amazon receiving stock options worth up to $60 billion tied to purchase commitments.

items.headline: DeepSeek Begins Beta Testing of V4.1 Flash, a New Multimodal Model
items.summary: The interim model introduces a new architecture with native multimodal support and claims to beat V4 Pro on internal benchmarks, ahead of a planned official release and price cut around September 10.

items.headline: Agility Robotics' SEC Filing Reveals $1.8M Revenue, $140M Loss Ahead of SPAC Listing
items.summary: Financial details disclosed in Agility's S-4 filing show the humanoid robot maker's Digit robot is deployed at nine customer sites with over $300 million in multi-year orders, as the company prepares to go public via a $2.5 billion SPAC merger.

items.headline: Accenture and Google Cloud Launch Gemini Enterprise Business Group
items.summary: The new group pairs a 1,000-person forward-deployed engineer workforce with Google Cloud specialists to accelerate large-scale Gemini Enterprise deployments and agentic AI adoption across industries.

items.headline: Investigation Finds Meta Approved Hundreds of Ads With AI-Generated Child Abuse Imagery
items.summary: A Tech Transparency Project report identified 332 paid ads on Facebook and Instagram containing AI-generated CSAM between November 2025 and August 2026, many linking to Chinese-made 'nudifying' apps, despite Meta's ad review process.
